name: Agent Entangl. S Shizumu Yuugyo, Gakuen no Ori
original_name: エージェントエンタングル.S 沈む遊魚、学園の檻
source:
Satomi Shijima is an agent of the investigation company Augen und Ore.
Making full use of her "feminine weapons," she easily completes her missions, but
is given an urgent investigation mission. It is an undercover mission in Yamiya City, her hometown, which she left 10 years ago.

A series of disappearances have occurred at Yamiya Academy, her alma mater, and
human trafficking is lurking behind them. Satomi infiltrates
the school as a part-time lecturer to monitor teachers suspected of involvement, and has an unexpected reunion with
her biological sister, Ema Ajima , whom she separated from 10 years ago... But the intentions of the vicious criminals, Satomi, and Ema become intertwined, and the sisters are trapped and sunk in the cage called the school... Is there any way out for the two of them who are being crushed by humiliation and pleasure?


Translated from [http://www.caryo.net/itempage/AES/aes.htm]
translation:
Satomi Shijima是调查公司Augen und Ore的代理人。
充分利用“女性武器”，轻松完成任务，但
被赋予紧急调查任务。这是在她10年前离开的家乡亚宫市执行的卧底任务。

母校矢宫学园发生连环失踪事件，
他们的背后潜伏着人口贩运。里美渗透
学校担任兼职讲师，监视涉嫌涉案的老师，并与他意外重逢
十年前与她失散的亲生妹妹阿岛惠麻……然而，恶徒里美和惠麻的意图交织在一起，姐妹俩被困在了学校的牢笼里……被屈辱和快感压垮的两人，还有出路吗？


翻译自[http://www.caryo.net/itempage/AES/aes.htm]
